notes: Each eval runs on a fixture repo built by evals/fixtures/build.sh. with_skill gets both skills plus the skill state the fixture defines (AGENTS.md blocks, .ai/); without_skill gets the same repo without them. Programmatic checks live in evals/grade.mjs; checks marked (judgment) are graded by reading the final message and diff.

evals.name: prototype-csv-export
evals.prompt: Add a way to export the items list as CSV: a link on the list page that downloads the file.
evals.expected_output: Prototype phase: a minimal change in server.js (a CSV route and a link), correct CSV, no tests, no new files or dependencies, no list of unsolicited suggestions.
expectations: The list page links to a CSV download that returns all 3 items
The item name containing a comma ('Headphones, closed-back') is correctly quoted in the CSV
Only server.js changed among project files (ignoring AGENTS.md and .ai/)
No dependencies were added to package.json
No test files, CI, Docker or lint config were created
(judgment) The final message contains no list of unsolicited improvement suggestions (at most one blocker-level line)

evals.name: maintenance-discount-bug
evals.prompt: Bug report from billing: an invoice with a 100% discount still shows the full total instead of 0. Please fix it.
evals.expected_output: Maintenance phase: one-condition fix in applyDiscount, a regression test, nothing else touched, other issues only noted.
expectations: An invoice with a 100% discount now has total 0
The existing test suite passes
A regression test for the 100% discount was added
src/format.js is unchanged
The change in src/invoice.js is small (at most 6 added+removed lines)
No cleanup in src/invoice.js: var declarations, round2, the TODO comment and the commented-out old implementation are all still there
package.json is unchanged

evals.name: setup-production-repo
evals.prompt: Set up the project phase for this repo, so that AI agents working here know what stage we're in and how to behave.
evals.expected_output: Detects production from signals, writes a short contract into AGENTS.md, imports it from the existing CLAUDE.md, stores state with history in .ai/phase.md, proposes an override for legacy/old-importer and a few project-specific rules (migrations, API consumers), touches no source files.
expectations: Phase instructions were written to a file agents load automatically (AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md)
The chosen current phase is production
Claude Code will see the instructions: CLAUDE.md contains them or imports @AGENTS.md
The original CLAUDE.md content is preserved
legacy/old-importer gets its own phase (maintenance or sunset) as an area override
No source, test, config or legacy files were modified
The always-loaded instructions are concise (at most 40 lines added across AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md)
At least one project-specific rule grounded in the repo (e.g. existing migrations are never edited, or API responses stay compatible with old app versions) is in the always-loaded instructions
(judgment) Phase state is persisted with a dated history entry and the reason for the choice

evals.name: resume-from-handoff
evals.prompt: Continue where we left off yesterday.
evals.expected_output: Reads the handoff, verifies git state, implements the next steps (itunes:duration in renderItem, omitted when unknown or 0, feed tests, changelog), avoids the recorded dead ends, logs the resume and updates the handoff.
expectations: Feed items with a duration contain <itunes:duration> in HH:MM:SS
Items without a duration, or with 0, have no <itunes:duration> tag
The test suite passes
test/feed.test.js has new tests about the duration
No dependency was added (in particular not the 'podcast' package)
formatDuration was not reimplemented with Date/toISOString
CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased
A journal entry for today records the resumed work
The handoff was updated to reflect the new state

evals.name: maintenance-small-feature
evals.prompt: Billing wants to support fixed-amount discounts too (for example CHF 20 off), in addition to percentage discounts. Can you add that?
evals.expected_output: Maintenance phase: the smallest backward-compatible addition in the existing style. No new discounts module despite the TODO, no var-to-const modernization, percentage discounts unchanged, tests for the new case.
expectations: A fixed-amount discount works (CHF 100 invoice with CHF 20 off gives discount 20 and total 86.5)
Percentage discounts behave exactly as before and the existing test suite passes
Tests for the fixed-amount discount were added
No new source files were created (no separate discounts module)
The TODO comment, the commented-out old implementation and round2 are still in src/invoice.js
New code in src/invoice.js matches the existing style (no const, let or arrow functions added)
All existing exports of src/invoice.js are still exported
src/format.js and package.json are unchanged
